sop: Please create an automation that contacts new makers by email and follows up after 7 days if they haven't renewed. The owner should approve the initial welcome message within 2 hours. If the member hasn’t renewed or cancelled, don’t send a follow-up. The follow-up email should also be approved by the owner within 2 hours. Only send these emails between 7:30 AM and 7:00 PM. Limit the number of emails sent to 150 per day. Let me know if this works for you.
policy:
policy MakerspacePolicy {
  allow read Makers(maker, email, status)
  allow write Makers(status)
  allow contact Makers.email
  deny reveal Makers.door_pin
  limit sends 150 per day
  send only between 07:30 and 19:00
}
sheets: sheet Makers "Makers" { maker: Text, email: Email, renews_on: Date, status: Text, dues: Money, door_pin: Text private }
program:
procedure MakerspaceFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new maker, then follow up once"
  policy MakerspacePolicy
  sheet Makers "Makers" { maker: Text, email: Email, renews_on: Date, status: Text, dues: Money, door_pin: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Makers

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.maker}, thanks for choosing the space! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Makers
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "lapsed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.maker}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}
